content: WorkManager: process killed mid-run => worker never returned result, WM re-runs it when constraints allow — work must be idempotent/checkpointed. setForeground on API 34+ needs declared FGS type in manifest AND in ForegroundInfo else MissingForegroundServiceTypeException. Android 15 caps dataSync AND mediaProcessing FGS at 6h combined per 24h; onTimeout() then crash if not stopped; quota resets when app foregrounded; no API to query remaining quota. Expedited work ~10 min quota from standby bucket.
